Crosswalk between two boundary vintages

Source: R/crosswalk.R
ntl_crosswalk.Rd

Builds the weights needed to move tabular data between two sets of administrative units, for example Kazakhstan's oblasts before and after the 2022 reform that created Abai, Zhetysu and Ulytau regions.

Usage

ntl_crosswalk(
  from,
  to,
  from_id,
  to_id,
  weight_raster = NULL,
  min_share = 0.001
)

Arguments

from, to

Polygons of the old and new vintage (sf or SpatVector).

from_id, to_id

Identifier columns in from and to.

weight_raster

Optional SpatRaster used for weighting.

min_share

Pieces holding less than this share of both their from and to unit are treated as digitising slivers and dropped before re-normalising.

Value

An ntl_crosswalk data frame with from_id, to_id, area_km2, weight, w_from (share of the from unit going to to; use for extensive variables such as totals), w_to (share of the to unit coming from from; use for intensive variables such as rates) and relation (unchanged, split, merge or split-merge).

Details

Nighttime lights themselves never need a crosswalk: extract them again with the other boundaries. Crosswalks matter for official statistics (GRP, employment, tax revenue) that exist only in one vintage and must be merged with a lights panel built on the other.

Weights come from the area of each intersection piece or, better for economic variables, from a raster such as nighttime lights or population summed over each piece (weight_raster). Units whose raster total is zero fall back to area weights.

Examples

ex <- ntl_example()
xw <- ntl_crosswalk(ex$units_old, ex$units_new, "district", "district_new")
xw
#>   from_id to_id area_km2   weight weight_source w_from w_to  relation
#> 1      D1   D1a 23674.16 23674.16          area    0.5  1.0     split
#> 2      D1   D1b 23674.16 23674.16          area    0.5  1.0     split
#> 3      D2    D2 47348.33 47348.33          area    1.0  1.0 unchanged
#> 4      D3    D3 47348.33 47348.33          area    1.0  1.0 unchanged
#> 5      D4    D4 50254.53 50254.53          area    1.0  1.0 unchanged
#> 6      D5   D56 50254.53 50254.53          area    1.0  0.5     merge
#> 7      D6   D56 50254.53 50254.53          area    1.0  0.5     merge
